category: uptime monitoring and status pages with real user monitoring

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 10 monitors, heartbeats and domains in total at a 5-minute check interval from 3 regions, 3 months of uptime logs, 3 status pages, 1,000 real user monitoring page views a month, email alerts and 1 webhook per monitor, no API
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the monitor, heartbeat or domain, 10 in total. The Free column also lists 1 webhook per monitor and a custom domain for status pages.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: 3 months of historical uptime logs and 3 months of analytics on Free, with error logs kept 30 days

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; the Free plan has no API to read monitor data back

interface_detail: The pricing page lists API, MCP and n8n access as not available on Free and available from the Solo plan, so the Free plan is reached through the web dashboard only; the interface vocabulary has no term for a browser-only service.
tooling: the web dashboard, email alerts, one webhook per monitor and public status pages; no API on Free
chaining: External uptime, SSL, port and keyword checks every 5 minutes from 3 regions on up to 10 endpoints of free-hosted services, with 3 public status pages on a custom domain and email alerts.

limits.value: 10 monitors, heartbeats and domains in total
1,000 real user monitoring page views a month
3 months of uptime logs and analytics, 30 days of error logs

limits_note: Free has no API, MCP or n8n access, so monitors are created in the web dashboard, and no Slack, Microsoft Teams or Datadog alerts.
binding_note: The 10-monitor cap fills before the 3 status pages matter, and the missing API means every monitor is set up by hand in the dashboard.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form offers Google or SSO sign-in, or an email address and a password, behind a Google reCAPTCHA; no payment field appears on it. Whether a later step asks for a card or a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read beyond the 3-month log and analytics retention and the 30-day error log retention
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from the first-party pricing page and the sign-up form from the sign-up page. No account was opened, so any step after the form is unverified: behind a sign-up.
